text: Four weeks in, the Store 06 trend hasn't resolved -- it's gotten more specific and more uncomfortable. Its employee discount line is running at roughly nine percent of gross sales, against a company average of one and a half.
Checked week by week, not just as a four-week total, the pattern holds every single week -- which is what elevates this from worth watching to worth escalating now.

The discipline here is separating what the data shows from what it might mean. It shows a sustained ratio. It does not show misuse, a policy difference, a training gap, or any individual's involvement -- and the note can't say otherwise.

The finding gets written up in fact-only language and sent privately, directly to the VP of Operations -- never to a shared dashboard comment, never to a group channel -- because deciding what happens next isn't a call that belongs with the person who built the report.
Even asked directly for an opinion, the honest answer stays the same: the number is real, the cause isn't something this data alone can prove. Next: presenting the finished platform.
